titulo: Me waiting for my drink to cool
caption:
Me waiting for my drink to cool

Me waiting for my drink to cool.

Very hot drinks are hard on your mouth and throat. A few minutes of waiting is a kindness to both.

Send it to the friend who always burns their tongue.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A glass with a steaming hot drink stands on the right. A small amber block figure with white eyes leans in to try it, jumps back with wide eyes as a bubble says hot!, and tries again with a bubble that says still hot. The steam fades away while it waits and looks around. The third time its eyes turn happy and a bubble says ahh. At the end it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me waiting for my drink to cool.
